descriptions.zh: 我们辨别出了一些隐藏于§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!地下的结构，似乎有着很悠久的历史。应该借此机会进行调查。
descriptions.en: We have identified several obscured subterranean structures on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! that appear to be of considerable age. We should take this opportunity to investigate.

sections.en: We have identified several obscured subterranean structures on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! that appear to be of considerable age. We should take this opportunity to investigate.

descriptions.zh: 在这个星系中我们截获了一系列怪异的电磁信号。初步数据分析表明这些发报器也许有数千年的历史。我们的船员渴望找到它的源头。
descriptions.en: We've picked up a series of strange electronic signals inside this system. Preliminary data shows these transmissions might be thousands of years old. Our crew is keen to find their origin.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]恒星系中发现了一颗红色的行星，颜色很深。我们应该对此开展调查。
descriptions.en: A scarlet planet was surveyed in the [From.GetStarName] system. The intensity of the color is remarkable. We should investigate.

descriptions.zh: 宇宙风暴经过后，出现了一颗组成成分极不寻常的彗星。它似乎是由有机材料组成的。我们的[solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切想要进行调查。
descriptions.en: A cosmic storm has left behind a comet of unusual composition. It appears to be made of organic material. Our [solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are keen to investigate.

descriptions.zh: 自从一场虚境风暴肆虐该恒星系后，我们就开始不断收到一些奇怪的信号。然而，当我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]想要回应这些呼叫时，信号又中断了。科学家们建议派出一艘科研船进行调查。
descriptions.en: Ever since a Shroud Storm raged through this system, we've been receiving strange signals. However, as soon as our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] try to answer this cacophony of hails, it dissipates again. They recommend sending a science vessel.

descriptions.zh: 轨道上的这个物体是途经的宇宙风暴带来的。它看上去像是一座空间站，但是对其结构组成的扫描结果却有点令人费解。我们建议对此开展调查。
descriptions.en: This orbiting object has been left behind by a passing cosmic storm. It looks like a space station but scans of its structural composition is returning most confusing results. We recommend investigating.

descriptions.zh: 在调查完[From.Planet.GetName]后，我们发现了一种奇特的生物。尽管我们只和它们相处了一会，但这已经激发了我们的保护欲。建议开展进一步的研究。
descriptions.en: After a survey of [From.Planet.GetName], a strange creature was discovered. Despite having only been among us for a short time, it has already instilled a deep  desire to nurture and protect it. Further study is advised.

sections.zh: 在调查完[From.Planet.GetName]后，我们发现了一种奇特的生物。尽管我们只和它们相处了一会，但这已经激发了我们的保护欲。建议开展进一步的研究。

descriptions.zh:
[fleet.GetName]的扫描仪显示[From.GetStarName]恒星系中漂浮着一座被废弃的空间站。

看起来它是被途径的宇宙风暴卷到这里来的。里面没有探测到生命，也没有任何形式的能量信号。空间站两侧则伸出来一对巨大的望远镜。这对光学设备看起来很先进，不过其尺寸相对于空间站而言还是显得太大了。整个空间站的所展现的科技与结构对于我们而言还是比较陌生。

我们可以试着重启这组望远镜，这或许能给我们带来一些有趣的洞见。
descriptions.en:
Scans performed by the [fleet.GetName] indicate the presence of a derelict space station in the [From.GetStarName] System.

It looks like it was deposited there by a passing cosmic storm. Life signs return negative, and there are no power signals of any kind. Two massive telescopes protrude from opposite sides of the station. These optical instruments appear advanced, and far too large relative to the station's size. The technology and architecture are not yet familiar to us.

We could attempt to reactivate the telescopes, as this could yield some interesting insights.

descriptions.zh: 在最近的一次调查中发现了一个单独的逃生舱。奇怪的是，这个逃生舱用与我们相同的数据签名向我们打招呼。这个逃生舱似乎是被最近一场穿过这个星系的宇宙风暴所带过来的。建议进行更深入的调查。
descriptions.en: A lone escape pod was spotted during a recent survey. Strangely, the pod hailed us using a data signature matching that of our own. The pod seems to have been displaced by a recent cosmic storm that passed through the system. Investigation is recommended.

descriptions.zh: 宇宙风暴过境[from.solar_system.GetName]星系时改变了该恒星的外观。在风暴的余波过后，这颗恒星的日冕层呈现出异彩纷呈的漩涡，向四面八方喷射出五光十色的耀斑。这一现象值得进一步分析。
descriptions.en: The passing of a cosmic storm through the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has transformed the visual appearance of the system's star. In the aftermath of the storm, the star's coronal layer presents as a swirl of ever-changing colors, ejecting polychromatic flares in all directions. The phenomenon warrants further analysis.

descriptions.zh: 一场路过的宇宙风暴致使[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中产生了三颗新的小行星。这些天体容易发生难以解释的方向变化，因此无法预测它们的轨迹。此事需要进一步的研究。
descriptions.en: A passing cosmic storm deposited three new asteroids in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. These celestial bodies are prone to inexplicable changes of direction, making it impossible to predict their trajectories. Further research is needed.
